title: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Work — Simple Present
titleVi: IELTS Speaking Part 1: Công việc — Thì Hiện Tại Đơn

speakingCueCard.prompt: Do you have a part-time job?

questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
questionPromptVi: Đọc đoạn văn dưới đây. Chọn mỗi lỗi ngữ pháp bạn phát hiện bằng cách bôi đen. Bạn có thể gõ bản sửa đúng vào ô hiện ra.
passageText: Yes, I work at a bookshop near my university three days a week. My boss always give me the evening shift because I have classes in the morning. The pay is not great, but I like being around books all day. It don't really affect my studies because I manage my time quite well.

errors.explanation: 'My boss' is third-person singular — the verb needs -s: 'gives', not 'give'.
errors.explanationVi: 'My boss' là ngôi thứ ba số ít — động từ cần thêm -s: 'gives', không phải 'give'.

errors.explanation: 'It' is third-person singular, so the negative form requires 'doesn't', not 'don't'.
errors.explanationVi: 'It' là ngôi thứ ba số ít, nên dạng phủ định phải dùng 'doesn't', không phải 'don't'.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'I work' is correct simple present — first person uses the base form.

collocations.exampleSentence: I prefer the evening shift because the shop is usually quieter.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Evening shift' — không cần mạo từ 'the' khi nói chung, nhưng dùng 'the' khi chỉ cụ thể

collocations.exampleSentence: She exercises three days a week to keep fit.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Days a week' dùng 'a', không dùng 'per' trong văn nói — 'three days a week' tự nhiên hơn 'three days per week'

collocations.sourceInPassage: I manage my time quite well
collocations.exampleSentence: University students need to manage their time carefully to balance work and study.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Manage time' — không dùng 'control time' hay 'handle time'

collocations.exampleSentence: As a book lover, I enjoy being around books wherever I go.
collocations.grammarNote: 'Like + V-ing' cho thói quen thích — 'like being around' không phải 'like to be around' (cả hai đúng nhưng V-ing tự nhiên hơn)

generationMatrix.discourseSituation: A student directly describing their part-time job routine
